svg.title: CARLOS CAETANO — Backend Developer · Payments
svg.desc: Profile card for CARLOS CAETANO, Backend Developer · Payments. I'm a backend developer working on payments in Elixir. I study API security too, mostly because breaking things teaches you how to build them better. When I'm away from the keyboard I'm usually on a trail, on a climbing wall, or practicing the saxophone (not well, but regularly). Stack: Elixir, Phoenix, Ecto, Oban, PostgreSQL, Docker, AWS, GitHub Actions, Python, Java. Certifications: Certified API Red Team Analyst (API-RTA) · CyberWarFare Labs.
